name: BMD rainfall intensity display rules

input.meaning: Peak daily rainfall supplied by caller. Do not use annual average as this input.

classes.label: Light
classes.floodLandslideText: Light rainfall band. Local waterlogging can still occur where drainage is poor.

classes.label: Heavy
classes.floodLandslideText: Heavy rainfall band. Monitor local flood exposure and drainage; slope areas may need extra caution.

classes.label: Very Heavy
classes.floodLandslideText: Very heavy rainfall band. Elevated flood and landslide concern, especially near rivers, low-lying areas and unstable slopes.

boundary_summary: 44 mm or less = Light. More than 44 mm through 88 mm = Heavy. More than 88 mm = Very Heavy.
disclaimer: Display aid only. Not official warning, forecast, evacuation guidance or substitute for Bangladesh Meteorological Department alerts.
